coreConfiguration: Published brikk-sql 67c74a6 uses the native Doris tokenizer and recognizes Doris half-open partition bounds. SqlScriptSnapshot retains trivia and refuses unbalanced boundaries. SqlScriptParameters.parse is the editor contract; parseParameterOccurrences remains strict for execution.

trivia.judgement: Accepted editor convention. Native omits whitespace-only tails; core retains every nonempty slice, including trailing trivia.
trivia.source: DorisParser.g4 multiStatements/singleStatement allow leading/trailing SEMICOLON tokens and optional statements; DorisLexer.g4 WS is hidden. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisParser.g4#L28-L34

hints.judgement: Native is the lexer oracle for optimizer hints. HINT_START competes with the longer recursive BRACKETED_COMMENT match; core must use equivalent lexical boundaries rather than exposing text inside a nested hint/comment as SQL. For incomplete hints, refusing parameter discovery is safer than scanning the recovered tail.
hints.source: DorisLexer.g4 HINT_START/HINT_END and recursive BRACKETED_COMMENT; DorisParser.g4 selectHint. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisLexer.g4#L661-L663

comments.judgement: Accepted named core residuals. The {#...;...#} case differs in statement and parameter discovery. An incomplete nested comment-only tail has a different hasSql flag. Neither difference authorizes execution of an incomplete boundary.
comments.source: DorisLexer.g4 SIMPLE_COMMENT: '--' ('\\\n' | ~[\r\n])* '\r'? '\n'?; BRACKETED_COMMENT recursively contains BRACKETED_COMMENT. Neither admits '#' or '{#'. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisLexer.g4#L745-L750

quotes.judgement: Native is right for Doris quoting boundaries: both single and double quotes admit backslash escapes; backticks admit doubled backticks. Dollar quoting is a distinct native literal. Unterminated lexical constructs must not expose a suffix.

dollar.judgement: Native is right: Doris recognizes untagged $$ literals, including embedded semicolons, colons and PIPE text. Core's Doris tokenizer does not configure dollar quoting. Tagged dollar strings are not this Doris grammar's literals.

colon.judgement: Native is the IDE-bind oracle. Map entry, STRUCT field and array-slice colons are syntax, not binds; :name elsewhere is the plugin's substitution syntax. PostgreSQL :: casts are absent from this Doris grammar and must not produce :INT as a bind.
colon.source: DorisParser.g4 arraySlice, mapLiteral, complexColType; DorisLexer.g4 COLON, with no double-colon token or cast production. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisParser.g4#L1725-L1730

pipe.judgement: Native is the ownership oracle: only contiguous | followed by a >-prefixed token claims PIPE, including malformed |>> tails. PIPE is an IDE extension; native Doris grammar has PIPE '|' and comparison tokens, not a PIPE-stage production.
pipe.source: DorisLexer.g4 PIPE, DOUBLEPIPES, GT/GTE; DorisPipes.chunks ownership gate. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisLexer.g4#L644-L659

unbalanced.judgement: Core's conservative refusal is safer for malformed SQL, but it is not exact native boundary parity. Native splits at every SEMICOLON token even with unmatched brackets; core deliberately retains the whole unbalanced remainder. Doris multiStatements still uses SEMICOLON delimiters, while these expressions are invalid.
unbalanced.source: DorisParser.g4 multiStatements, primaryExpression, arraySlice; core SqlScriptSnapshot bracket tracking. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisParser.g4#L28-L34

parameter-refusal.judgement: Core intentionally requires one fully parseable statement; native lexically scans scripts and incomplete editor input. Refusal is appropriate for unproved execution input, but this is a scanner-contract disagreement, not evidence that native spans are wrong. :name is an IDE substitution convention, not a native Doris server placeholder.
parameter-refusal.source: Core shape/SqlParameters.kt parseParameterOccurrences explicitly rejects zero/multiple statements and propagates parser/token failures. DorisParser.g4 multiStatements permits scripts; native DorisPipes.namedParameterRanges operates on default-channel lexer tokens. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisParser.g4#L28-L34

opaque-tail-parameters.judgement: Accepted editor contract. Core stops parameter discovery at the first lexical failure. Native recovers incomplete constructs as ordinary tokens and reports phantom binds inside them. Ten incomplete lexical-tail cases and the already listed incomplete STRUCT case retain this intentional difference.
opaque-tail-parameters.source: DorisLexer.g4 complete STRING_LITERAL/BACKQUOTED_IDENTIFIER/BRACKETED_COMMENT productions and UNRECOGNIZED recovery; DorisParser.g4 requires closing delimiters. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisLexer.g4#L745-L762

native-struct-false-binds.judgement: Core is right. :INT and :MAP in ARRAY<STRUCT<a:INT,b:MAP<STRING,INT>>> are field/type syntax, not parameters. The native scanner's nested-type group probing reports false binds; only :p and :after are IDE substitutions. Do not fix core to reproduce this native bug.
native-struct-false-binds.source: DorisParser.g4 complexDataType recursively permits ARRAY, MAP and STRUCT; complexColType is identifier COLON dataType. https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/3226e0c28acf04db96878a6afc7013315defe75c/fe/fe-sql-parser/src/main/antlr4/org/apache/doris/nereids/DorisParser.g4#L1864-L1869 and #L1917-L1919
